source.name: NISMO: Nissan Formula E Team confirms Zane Maloney alongside Oliver Rowland for Season 13
source.note: Opened 2026-11-28. Confirms the team races in 2026/27 at all and that the manufacturer's name carries the entry; the team-title brand is mapped to the front per the league note. The Season 13 livery itself is not publicly revealed until 2026-12-06, so other placements are unconfirmed.
source.quote: Nissan Formula E Team will field Oliver Rowland and Zane Maloney as its driver line-up for the 2026/27 ABB FIA Formula E World Championship, which marks the first season of the new GEN4 era.

summary: Season 13 (2026/27) GEN4 entry. Only the manufacturer's own name is confirmed for the car: the GEN4-era driver line-up was announced on 2026-08-26 and the team ran a testing livery at Madrid pre-season testing, but the race livery and its partner set are not revealed until 2026-12-06, so the Season 12 partner list (Electromin, Coral, Marelli, Reflo, Dynisma, Alpinestars) is not carried forward here. sponsorsComplete is false for that reason.
